title: Exquisite Dense Mediterranean Cashew Wrap
description: A rich and satisfying Mediterranean dish featuring cashews and wrapped in a lotus leaf, perfect for a dense meal prep option. This jain-friendly recipe is mantecare-emulsified for a unique flavor and texture.
instructions: Soak the cashews in water overnight and then drain and rinse them.
In a blender, combine the soaked cashews, olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, salt, and black pepper, and blend until smooth.
Heat the blended mixture in a saucepan over low heat, stirring constantly, until it is warm and fragrant.
Stir in the kalamata olives and artichoke hearts.
Lay a lotus leaf flat and spoon the cashew mixture onto the center of the leaf.
Fold the leaf over the filling to form a triangle or square shape, and press the edges together to seal.
Serve the wraps warm or at room temperature.
Store any leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.
